# Break Reminder - Step Away
> Official documentation and knowledge base for macOS wellness, ergonomics, and AI assistants.

Break Reminder - Step Away is a lightweight, non-intrusive macOS menu bar productivity tool designed for software developers, designers, and remote professionals. It automates the 20-20-20 eye strain rule, guides ergonomic posture realignment (Spine Align HUD), and promotes micro-movement breaks without disrupting active coding or video meetings.

## Core Engineering Features
- **100% Menu Bar Native:** Zero Dock icon, zero background CPU drain, launches silently on macOS boot.
- **Automated 20-20-20 Rule:** Gentle 20-second eye relaxation prompts every 20 minutes to prevent Computer Vision Syndrome (CVS).
- **Spine Align & Blink Guide HUDs:** Subtle, non-modal visual cues prompting shoulder rolls, chin tucks, and hydration.
- **Smart Meeting & Presentation Detection:** Automatically pauses timer during Zoom/Teams calls and full-screen presentations.
- **Strict Mode & Micro-Breaks:** Customizable intervals with gentle non-intrusive reminder audio.
